name: r0_poss_half_pbrs999
description: r0_poss_half with the two distance channels switched from the pinned legacy raw delta-Phi to exact discounted PBRS at gamma=0.999. Exactly one declared factor differs from r0_poss_half (reward_dist_pbrs_gamma absent under schema 1, which means legacy raw delta, -> 0.999); every coefficient is identical. It separates the horizon change (train gamma 0.995 -> 0.999, chains 25/26, D392/D393) from the legacy distance-bias change that rides with it (D391). gamma MUST equal train.gamma, so this arm trains only as LADDER_ARM with LADDER_GAMMA=0.999; the screen and the arm launcher both refuse it at any other gamma.
